# Generated images of the site

These are illustrations, not pictures of the product: no file here shows the ZPLC application, a real board (the boards drawn
are generic), a person or any text.
Screenshots of the application are elsewhere (`editors/`, `tutorials/`, `learn/`) and are registered in `../manifest.json`.

Every file was generated with the Antigravity CLI (`agy` 1.4.5, its image generation tool) on 2026-10-22 (the boards on
2026-10-24), from the prompt file named below (in `docs/design/prompts/`), in a scratch folder outside the repository, then
reviewed by eye against the rules of `docs/design/image-plan.md` and converted once to AVIF with ImageMagick:

```
magick <generated>.png -quality 72 hero-rung-to-terminal.avif                 # the hero, at its size
magick <generated>.png -resize 720x -quality 72 hero-rung-to-terminal-720.avif   # the hero for narrow screens
magick <generated>.png -resize 1080x -quality 72 hero-rung-to-terminal-1080.avif # the hero for narrow high-density screens
magick <generated>.png -resize 900x672 -quality 72 plant-<name>-<mode>.avif   # the plants
magick <generated>.png -quality 72 boards-on-rail-<mode>.avif                  # the boards, at their size
```

The tool returns 1376 x 768 for a 16:10 request and 1200 x 896 for 4:3; it does not take an exact size.
